200.summary: Polish deputy PM proposes “constitutional reset” to resolve crisis around top court Nov 6, 2026 | Law , Politics Keep our news free from ads and paywalls by making a donation to support our work!
200.body: Polish deputy PM proposes “constitutional reset” to resolve crisis around top court Nov 6, 2026 | Law , Politics Keep our news free from ads and paywalls by making a donation to support our work! The leader of one of the parties in Poland’s ruling coalition has put forward plans for a “constitutional reset” that he hopes can resolve the crisis around the country’s top court. The proposal, presented on Thursday by deputy prime minister Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz, head of the centre-right Polish People’s Party (PSL), would remove all current judges on the Constitutional Tribunal (TK) and allow new judges to be chosen only with the approval of 60% of members of parliament and the president.

200.body: Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania and Poland urge EU to end investment treaties with Russia Date: 06 November 2026 Add ZMINA as a source on Google A+ A- To receive useful materials, subscribe to our newsletter Subscribe Estonia, Latvia , Lithuania and Poland have called on the European Commission to ensure the termination of bilateral investment treaties with Russia, which remain in force in 17 EU countries. 400.title: India’s Adani Agrees to Buy Europe’s 2nd-Largest Liquid Storage Operator
400.summary: Already India’s largest port terminal operator, Adani continues to seek opportunities to expand its international footprint and build a foothold in Europe. Netherlands-based Evos is Europe’s second-largest independent liquid storage operator, with 6.3 mn cubic meters of storage capacity at eight port-based terminals across the Netherlands, Germany, Spain, Belgium, and Malta.
400.body: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Limited (APSEZ) agreed to acquire Netherlands-headquartered Evos B.V. from Igneo Infrastructure Partners in a deal with an enterprise value of €2.56 billion ($2.87 billion). Already India’s largest port terminal operator, Adani continues to seek opportunities to expand its international footprint and build a foothold in Europe. “Evos marks an important milestone in APSEZ’s trajectory towards handling 1 billion tons of cargo and building a truly global, integrated transport platform,” said Karan Adani, Managing Director of APSEZ. Netherlands-based Evos is Europe’s second-largest independent liquid storage operator, with 6.3 mn cubic meters of storage capacity at eight port-based terminals across the Netherlands, Germany, Spain, Belgium, and Malta.

400.body: Christine Lagarde, president of the European Central Bank (ECB), is urging Europe to speed up its investment in climate change adaptation. 500.body: Microsoft is extending undisclosed usage caps to additional Copilot Chat features for enterprise users who already pay for Microsoft 365 subscriptions but do not hold separate Microsoft 365 Copilot licenses, restricting access to certain AI capabilities and nudging users to upgrade to a paid Copilot-specific license. Before the change, commercial users could access Copilot Chat at no additional cost through eligible Microsoft 365 business and enterprise subscriptions, including Business Basic, Business Standard, Business Premium, Office 365 E3 and E5, and Microsoft 365 E3 and E5. While Microsoft already applied fair-use limits to certain capabilities, such as image generation, it is now extending usage restrictions to additional Copilot Chat features, without specifying which capabilities will be affected or disclosing the thresholds governing their use.

600.body: At the halfway stage of the competition, both Polish clubs have lost three of their four matches.
